title: boundver config
description: Declares repository components, their contract identities, downstream consumers, and optional slices.

relativePath.description: A non-empty repository- or component-relative path using '/' separators, with no absolute or parent traversal.

consumerGraphIdentifier.description: A bounded label for a downstream system represented in the consumer graph.

componentIdentifier.description: A component name with no comma or leading or trailing whitespace.

gitTagPrefix.description: A bounded literal prefix for refs/tags/<prefix><semver>. The final partial component may end with '/', '.', or '.lock' only when appending the version makes the completed tag valid.

$schema.description: Optional URL used by editors to locate this JSON Schema; it is not fetched by boundver.

project.description: Human-readable name of the repository or contract project.

providers.description: Custom providers. Loading requires an explicit --allow-custom-providers flag or trusted environment opt-in.

items.description: One explicitly trusted custom Python provider declaration.

module.description: Importable Python module containing the provider class.

class.description: Provider class name exported by the declared module.

name.description: Public provider name, which must begin with 'custom.'.

defaults.description: Repository-wide settings: compat_mode applies to every component, while verify_facets is the fallback policy for components without an override.

compat_mode.description: How a parsed version is reduced to the compatibility family recorded by the compat facet.

verify_facets.description: Facets that fail verification by default when a component does not override the policy.

items.description: One component identity to gate during verification.

coverage.description: Read-only declaration-coverage policy. It does not affect fingerprints, lock entries, slices, or verification.

source_indicators.description: Repository-relative selectors identifying source files whose directories should be owned by a component or vendored-copy declaration.

exclusions.description: Intentional omissions from ownership, behavior, or boundary coverage; every exclusion requires a reason.

paths.description: Repository-relative selectors for files intentionally omitted from the named coverage facets.

facets.description: Coverage dimensions from which matching paths are intentionally excluded.

reason.description: Human-readable justification shown beside every matching excluded path.

derivations.description: Named generated-artifact relations verified from committed receipts without executing repository commands.

additionalProperties.description: A deterministic relation between source inputs, generated boundary outputs, and a trusted generator identity.

inputs.description: Repository-relative files, directories, or globs consumed by the trusted generator.

outputs.description: Repository-relative generated files, directories, or globs also selected by a component boundary.

evidence.description: Literal repository-relative .boundver-derivation.json path to the committed boundver-derivation/v1 receipt.

generator.description: Stable logical identity of the trusted generator; this value is data and is never executed.

components.description: Named repository components whose identities and downstream relationships are recorded.

additionalProperties.description: A component root, its available identity inputs, and its downstream consumers.

path.description: Repository-relative root containing the component's tracked files.

ecosystem.description: Human-facing technology or package-ecosystem label; it does not affect semantic configuration identity.

note.description: Human-facing component context; does not affect semantic configuration identity.

version_source.description: Source of the version reduced into the compat facet, or null when the component has no compat identity.

oneOf.description: Read a version field from a JSON, TOML, or YAML file inside the component.

file.description: Component-relative manifest file containing the version.

field.description: Field path read from the version manifest.

oneOf.description: Read a version from Git's closest reachable tag matching a prefix; the remaining suffix must be SemVer.

git_tag_prefix.description: Literal prefix passed to Git tag matching; the suffix of the closest reachable match must be SemVer.

oneOf.description: Inherit the resolved version of another configured component from the same selected source.

component.description: Configured component whose resolved version supplies this component's compatibility identity.

oneOf.description: Use an explicit SemVer compatibility identity when no repository file or tag owns it.

constant.description: Explicit SemVer value included in semantic configuration identity.

boundary.description: The artifact this component publishes and the provider that gives it a deterministic identity.

provider.description: Registered built-in or explicitly enabled custom provider name.

paths.description: Component-relative literal paths or case-sensitive glob patterns selected by the provider.

note.description: Human-facing rationale for the boundary declaration; it does not affect semantic configuration identity.

behavior.description: Behavior-relevant paths, normally a superset of boundary paths.

paths.description: Component-relative paths or patterns for defaults, migrations, configuration, or other observable behavior inputs.

vendored_copies.description: Repository-relative directories whose complete tracked trees must match the component under boundver's content-only digest; text CRLF and LF line endings are equivalent.

consumers.description: Configured component names directly downstream of this component.

external_consumers.description: Opaque terminal labels for downstream systems not configured as components.

verify_facets.description: Component-specific gated facets used when --facets is not passed.

slices.description: Named group identities computed from one facet across explicit members or a downstream closure.

additionalProperties.description: One named multi-component digest used for verification or cache routing.

mode.description: Facet contributed by resolved members to the slice digest. With generate --allow-partial, a member that lacks this facet contributes a null marker to the aggregate.

components.description: Explicit non-empty list of configured component names in this slice.

closure_of.description: Include this component and its transitive downstream consumers.
